searchText: My call notes here: https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/rkEn7C_88 Please lmk or edit directly if any typos/inaccuracies 😄 thanks ben! notes look great (unlisted) link to networking call -- https://youtu.be/F6c6BJ285Mc [cc <@!491624610215886849> ] Thanks <@291925846556540928> I want to clarify the language here for verifying a gossip'ed block > The proposer signature, signed_beacon_block.signature, is valid The proposer index is not in play right? (ie it doesn't have to be the correct proposer index corresponding to the slot of the block) we've added a condition in `v011x` to be released asap. first, we check that the proposer index is correct wrt expected shuffling (and if we can't immediately tell, we MAY queue the block as we go calculate shuffling) https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/v011x/specs/phase0/p2p-interface.md#global-topics Ahh ok thanks. I thought that was weird. Glad I asked This ensures that we don't have a size N-1 DoS vector at each slot (for non-assigned proposers) Hey <@!291925846556540928> pre-genesis, should we be skipping the eth2 enrforkID verification checks? doesnt make sense to have to wait till chainstart to find and connect to peers ah, yes we talked about this a little on a previous call but didn't address it in the spec. We do need an allowance to find peers prior to genesis... we can bypass forkid.. could also potentially use the deposit contract address, but that doesn't map well to non-eth1 started eth2 chains the bypass would work for us for now it's fine today, but might make it hard to find (good) peers when starting up testnets and things after we start mainnet working on a couple of networking PRs right now. I'll come back to this shortly > we've added a condition in `v011x` to be released asap. first, we check that the proposer index is correct wrt expected shuffling (and if we can't immediately tell, we MAY queue the block as we go calculate shuffling) > > https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/v011x/specs/phase0/p2p-interface.md#global-topics <@!291925846556540928> I would have thought it sensible to verify the signature, _then_ verify that the proposer index is correct for the shuffling. That way we're protected against random people (i.e., not deposited validators) from causing us to load some obscure state from disk and process a bunch of skip slots.
